description: This PHP source file defines a controller class 'SaveCustomFieldController' for handling custom field save operations within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It extends an abstract controller and utilizes services and traits to facilitate the rendering of Vue.js components for editing and saving custom fields, integrating internationalization and configuration of form components.

classes.name: SaveCustomFieldController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for rendering and managing user interactions related to saving custom fields in the OrangeHRM PIM module.

methods.name: getCustomFieldService
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns the CustomFieldService instance used by the controller.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with relevant properties for editing or creating a custom field, including internationalized labels and options.
